segments.text:
V. 44.
And be came ſorth, bouna hand and foot with grave-clothes— Which were wrapt round each Hand and each Foot. And his face was wrapt about with a napkin—If the Jews buried as the Egyptians did, the Face was not covered with it, but it only went round the Porchead, and under the Chin; ſo that he might eaſily ſee his Way.
